name: gaep-kiro
description: Governed local Product Studio, agent-readiness, selection, versioned handoff, managed read-only execution/evidence, and portable-design workflows for Kiro.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: GAEP for Kiro can show its static Product Studio boundary, but it does not inspect Product or Managed Run state, start the local engine, run managed read-only work, or import/read/list portable design metadata until the workspace is trusted.

commands.title: GAEP for Kiro: Open Product Studio
GAEP for Kiro: Show Codex and Claude Readiness
GAEP for Kiro: Select Codex or Claude Configuration
GAEP for Kiro: Create Versioned Agent Handoff
GAEP for Kiro: Attest and Run Managed Read-Only Work
GAEP for Kiro: Show Managed Run Evidence
GAEP for Kiro: Import Local Portable Design Bundle
GAEP for Kiro: List Portable Design Snapshots
GAEP for Kiro: Read Portable Design Snapshot

gaepKiro.engineExecutable.description: Machine-scoped local GAEP engine executable name or absolute path. Workspace overrides are ignored.

gaepKiro.engineSha256.description: Optional machine-scoped SHA-256 pin for the local GAEP engine executable. Workspace overrides are ignored.

gaepKiro.actorId.description: Portable human actor ID recorded for local imports, guarded agent selections, and versioned handoffs. It cannot contain credentials and workspace overrides are ignored.

scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository -o dist/gaep-kiro.vsix
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run package
